title: Lyon College Hosts First Give Veterans a Smile Event
html:
80 dental students participate in Give Veterans a Smile event

The Lyon College School of Dental Medicine hosted its first “Give Veterans a Smile” event on Tuesday, Nov. 10, providing free preventive dental services to military veterans at its campus in Little Rock.

Eighty dental school students participated, along with the school’s entire faculty and staff.

Veterans were offered free dental screening exams, fluoride treatments, oral hygiene instruction, toothbrushes, and dental hygiene goodie bags. The effort emphasized preventive oral health care while providing students with hands-on opportunities to serve veterans in their community.

The program was made possible through the generous support of donors, including presenting sponsors Advanced Spine & Pain Centers and Arkansas Blue Cross and Blue Shield, as well as Hope Church and Pulaski Heights United Methodist Church.

“We are extremely grateful to the donors whose generosity helped make today’s event possible,” said Bailey Faulkner, vice president of institutional advancement at Lyon College. “Lyon College is committed to serving our veterans and providing access to quality dental care, and we look forward to continuing that commitment. We invite anyone interested in learning more about our efforts to visit lyon.edu/dental.”

“Give Veterans a Smile reflects the heart of what we hope to accomplish at the Lyon College School of Dental Medicine,” said Dr. Burke Soffe, the school’s founding dean. “We are preparing future dentists to be not only excellent clinicians but also advocates for the health of the communities they serve.”

Vouchers were also made available to help veterans cover the cost of future dental care at the school. The vouchers have designated monetary values and may be applied toward eligible services, including comprehensive exams, extractions, and restorative treatment.

For more information about dental services offered by the Lyon College School of Dental Medicine, visit lyon.edu/dental.

About Lyon College

Lyon College, a private liberal arts institution founded in 1872, is the oldest college in the state with its original charter. Ranked by U.S. News & World Report as a 2024 “Best College,” Lyon currently enrolls 781 students from more than 33 states and 14 countries. Students can tailor their education, selecting from 31 majors, as well as preprofessional and individualized options and select graduate programs. Learn more at lyon.edu.
